article.title: Sellforte與Exact AI合作，為香港零售團隊導入AI衡量流程
article.title_en: Sellforte and Exact AI bring AI-enabled measurement onboarding to Hong Kong
article.summary: Sellforte在11月18日公布Exact AI亞太合作，客戶導入範圍包括香港、澳洲及新加坡。
article.summary_en: Sellforte's November 18 APAC partnership with Exact AI covers customer onboarding in Hong Kong, Australia and Singapore.
highlights: 平台結合營銷組合建模、增量測試、歸因與預算優化。
Sellforte AI及MCP可把結果帶入AI助理；夥伴協助日常決策與季度檢討。
highlights_en: The platform combines marketing mix modeling, incrementality testing, attribution and budget optimization.
AI and MCP connections bring results into assistants, with partner support for decisions and quarterly reviews.
article.why: 香港零售團隊新增本地區導入途徑，可先確認促銷、門店與網上銷售如何進入同一模型，再決定是否用於預算檢討。
article.why_en: Hong Kong retailers gain a regional onboarding route and can assess how promotions, store sales and ecommerce feed budget reviews.
article.next_step: 選一個同時有門店及網店的品牌，列清價格、促銷與銷售資料，要求夥伴示範模型假設如何連到季度預算建議。
article.next_step_en: For one omnichannel brand, list price, promotion and sales inputs and ask how model assumptions connect to quarterly budget recommendations.
article.detail: 這是11月18日的合作公告，本篇保留原日期，沒有把後續新聞稿重發當成新推出。營銷組合建模以整體資料估算渠道貢獻，結果需要結合資料覆蓋與假設解讀。編輯建議在選型時要求展示促銷及價格變化的處理方式，避免把模型估計直接當成已實測的增量回報；公告沒有提供香港客戶的獨立成效證據。
article.detail_en: This is the November 18 partnership announcement, not a later release date recast as a launch. Marketing mix models estimate contributions from aggregate data and depend on coverage and assumptions. Ask how price and promotion effects are handled. Model estimates are not independently measured incremental returns; no verified Hong Kong customer results are supplied.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
